notablePrerequisites:
Necrosynthesis attached to Tayam.
Young Wolf does not have a +1/+1 counter on it.
description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Young Wolf, adding {C}{C}.
When Young Wolf dies, its undying ability and Necrosynthesis trigger.
Resolve the Young Wolf trigger, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter and a vigilance counter on it.
Resolve the Necrosynthesis trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on Tayam.
Activate Tayam by paying {3}, removing a +1/+1 counter from Tayam, and both counters from Young Wolf.
Holding priority, activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Young Wolf, adding {C}{C}.
Repeat steps 2-4 one additional time.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Young Wolf, adding {C}{C}.
Resolve Tayam's ability from step 5, causing you to mill three cards and returning Young Wolf from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.
